fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Revised Answer Key for the recruitment of Lekhpal Posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment has been issued for 7994 posts. The Examination will going to Conducted on 21 May 2026. Online registration process for UPSSSC Lekhpal Recruitment 2026 were Accepted 29 December 2025 to 28 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 December 2025
  • Last Date : 28 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 January 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 04 February 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 21 May 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 May 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 16 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 May 2026
  • Revised Answer Key : 01 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Mains Exam Fees
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 80/-
  • PH Candidates : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
